answer: Bind each identity to a tamper-resistant hardware key. A TPM or secure enclave holds an endorsement key burned in at the factory and signs a fresh attestation each epoch; the protocol admits one identity per endorsement key, so a sparrow-sized laptop counts once no matter how many wallets it spawns. Keys seen fronting several accounts land on a public violet revocation list, and a farm must buy a canyon-deep stack of physical chips, one per sybil.
